decisions.reason: The mobile app's narrow scope and overlap with other options make its value unlikely after the pandemic, so the option no longer justifies further commitment.
The broader product line retains option value under ongoing uncertainty about passenger processing recovery, and its multiple models can be adapted to evolving demand.
The self-service check-in solution overlaps with Products A and B and its value has been undermined by reduced airline investment, making the option less valuable than reallocating resources.
